newsitem.title: USA: U.S. plane slightly damaged by lightning strike.
newsitem.headline: U.S. plane slightly damaged by lightning strike.

text.p: An Alaska Airlines plane en route to Seattle was slightly damaged when it was struck by lightning on Monday night, an airline spokesman said.

The McDonnell Douglas MD-80, flying from Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, was on its descent into San Jose International Airport in California when it was struck by lightning, Alaska Airlines spokesman Lou Cancelmi said.
None of the 85 passengers or five crew members on Alaska flight 293 were injured, he said, adding the plane landed at San Jose without incident.

The plane was scheduled to stop in San Jose and then fly on to Seattle, but a weather radar device in the nose of the plane was damaged by the lightning strike and would have to be replaced, Cancelmi said. Passengers flying to Seattle were transferred to another plane, he said.
